_status: PROPOSED 2026-10-20 - written from docs/PLAYBOOKS.md (triggers, agents, HITL gates) by Claude for the owner's review; runs carry table PROPOSED until the owner ratifies this file
_what: The dispatcher's playbook table (owner decision 2026-10-15: run tracker). Agents keep doing the work; the dispatcher matches each message against these starts and ends, tracks one run per playbook and client, holds when two playbooks match one start or when a new run conflicts with one already open on the same client, and writes an after-action report when a run ends. Priority classes are in identity/priority.json.
_patterns: A pattern matches a message on the hub: intent, from and to (an agent id or a list), and optional payload tests - has (keys that must be present and not null), eq (key: value), ne (key: value it must not have), in (key: [values]), prefix (key: text the value starts with); a key may name a nested field with dots (offer_status.stage). A pattern with audit instead of intent matches an audit-log entry of that kind, with the same tests on the entry. A human message may name the playbook it starts with payload.playbook. single_message: the run starts and ends on one message. supersedes: starting this playbook ends an open run of the named one on the same client (a hand-off, not a conflict). conflicts_with: a new run of this playbook while one of these is open on the same client holds both for your decision. listing: "live" when the message's client is one of the brokerage's listings, active on the MLS record; "not_live" otherwise (owner decision 2026-10-21: a comparables request is P23 on a live listing, P15 otherwise; P02 starts only from a signed price change).
